instruction: Configure fail2ban jail for nginx with custom bantime
output:
echo -e '[nginx-http]
enabled = true
port = http,https
filter = nginx-http-auth
logpath = /var/log/nginx/access.log
bantime = 86400
findtime = 600
maxretry = 5' > /etc/fail2ban/jail.d/nginx-custom.conf
